caption: An extreme close-up shows a white, translucent, lumpy mass with a porous, pitted surface and a few small dark holes near its upper edge. It rests against a pale yellow background with a dark band along the top of the frame. The irregular left rim curves inward to form a hollow, while the body looks soft and slightly glossy. A slender dark rod enters from the right and advances leftward toward the upper-right portion of the mass. Its tip approaches a small dark hole, and a strand of white substance hangs from the rod near that point. The rod then settles into a more horizontal position across the middle-right, while the mass and background shift relative to it. A bluish-tinted gap appears just behind the tool near the hollow, and the rod drifts downward and leftward across the frame. The framing of the mass and background shifts slightly throughout, and the interaction continues without resolving.
